Chapter 1011: Chapter 21 Lucky Human Civilization (Please Subscribe)_2

But things are much better now.

“By the way, when will the Great Collapse of the Universe arrive?”

The Void God Ultimate Being spoke to inquire.

“No more than three hundred years.”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned serious, as the avatar of Ancient Ming from the Chaos Continent, he constantly monitored this matter.

The battleground between the Nine Phoenix Great Saint and the Shadow Demon Great Saint was already not far from this region. Calculated by Chaos Void time, the ripple effects would reach here in no more than a year.

Whereas in the universe’s temporal measurement, that would be around three hundred years.

“The Chaos Great Saints are too terrifying.” The Void God Ultimate Being couldn’t help remarking.

Just the clash between two Chaos Great Saints was enough to unleash shockwaves that could collapse multiple universes, hastening their Great Collapse?

“Chaos Great Saints have already evolved their own powers out of the Chaos Rules. They can suppress Chaos Venerables with mere gestures.”

Lin Yuan explained.

Of course, Chaos Venerables have ways to preserve their lives. Even for peerless Great Saints, it’s incredibly difficult to annihilate a Chaos Venerable completely—they could only manage to destroy their true form and essence.

Yet even so, the intimidation from a Chaos Great Saint was unmatched; no Chaos Venerable would willingly lose their true form and essence, as it would mean losing most of their treasures and weapons—a loss that might take countless Cosmic Eras to recover.

“Next, the nine of us will personally act and relocate the citizens of our race,” Xia Qin, the Ultimate Being, spoke.

If the relocation was done one planet at a time, the involvement of Ultimate Beings would drastically increase efficiency—each thought spanning countless light-years.

…

In the human civilization’s territory.

On innumerable life planets, countless scenes of separation unfolded, as many citizens came to realize that this farewell might mean they would never reunite.

At that moment.

A message issued by three goddesses was simultaneously delivered to every citizen.

“Thanks to the great Galaxy Ultimate Being, the relocation plan for our race has been revised. The new plan abolishes the quota system—every citizen of human civilization is eligible for migration to the new universe.”

This news instantly set off a storm among the citizens of human civilization.

“Every citizen can migrate to the new universe?”

“We don’t have to wait for death?”

“Hahaha, this is incredible.”

…

Countless citizens of human civilization cried tears of joy. To be allowed to migrate to the new universe and survive—who would choose to stay on their doomed planets, awaiting death?

“It’s the Galaxy Ultimate Being; the Galaxy Ultimate Being ensures we survive.”

“The Galaxy Ultimate Being is the greatest Ultimate Being of human civilization.”

Many citizens of human civilization keenly noticed that the announcement from the three goddesses mentioned the Galaxy Ultimate Being at the forefront.

Though they didn’t know what methods the Galaxy Ultimate Being used to relocate all human civilization citizens to the new universe.

It was clear such an act came at an enormous cost; otherwise, why would there have been the original quota system where only one in over a hundred citizens could gain migration eligibility?

…

In the cosmic starry skies.

Other alien races were likewise informed of human civilization’s new migration plan.

Although these alien races had submitted to human civilization, they were still not citizens of humankind, hence excluded from human migration plans.

“Every citizen of the human civilization can migrate to the new universe?”

“Why can our race’s Twelve-Layer Ultimates only migrate one-millionth of our people?”

“Is it because of the Galaxy Ultimate Being?”

Many alien races felt deeply conflicted as they learned about this. Not long ago, Lin Yuan had set free all Twelve-Layer Ultimates, allowing them to return to their own races.

Human civilization announced the Great Collapse of the Universe, and the alien races that submitted to humanity naturally also became aware.

Similar to humanity, alien races with Twelve-Layer beings likewise formulated migration plans.

Even so, no matter how deep the legacy of the Yu Clan or others, they dared to transfer no more than one-millionth of their population.

With the Great Collapse of the Universe arriving early, the Twelve-Layer Ultimates hadn’t yet reached their full potential, and nearly all weaponry, tools, and rare treasures remained in Lin Yuan’s possession.

Migrating even one-millionth of their population represented how highly these alien Twelve-Layer Ultimates valued their own people.

After all, the Great Collapse wasn’t child’s play—the more life forms transported, the stronger the Universe Origin Source’s final backlash would be.

The likelihood of survival would correspondingly decrease.

“Is this the power of the Galaxy Ultimate Being?”

“What should we do? Should we completely submit to human civilization? That way we might survive?”

“Submit fully? That means becoming slaves of human civilization?”

“Compared to death, what are slaves?”

Many alien strong ones who didn’t gain migration eligibility grappled with such thoughts.

Total submission, or selling oneself, meant giving up everything and becoming the private property of human civilization.

Although the alien races bowed to humanity, they hadn’t yet sunk to the level of total subjugation.

But now, seeing human civilization rise thanks to the Galaxy Ultimate Being, they realized that by choosing complete submission, they might just survive.

…

“The Galaxy Ultimate Being plans to take every human citizen?”

“How is that possible? Does he not fear the backlash from the Universe Origin Source?”

Many Twelve-Layer alien beings received this information, and their first thought was disbelief.

Though alien beings below Twelve-Layer also found it inconceivable that the Galaxy Ultimate Being could relocate all human civilization citizens, they didn’t know why it was so astonishing and thus accepted the reality quickly, albeit with shock.

But those in the Twelve-Layer—alien ultimate beings—understood the gravity of this act.

It would provoke the Universe Origin Source’s full suppression; even if the Galaxy Master possessed Path Splitting Realm peak strength, perhaps even surpassing that, he couldn’t possibly endure the backlash.

“Perhaps, the Galaxy Ultimate Being’s power has reached a level beyond our comprehension…”

A Star Alliance Ultimate murmured, deducing the cause from the effect.

Though they didn’t know how the Galaxy Ultimate Being dared to relocate all human civilization citizens, the mere fact he dared confirmed two possibilities.

Either the Galaxy Ultimate Being was foolishly courting death.

Or he had enough assurance, believing he could withstand the Universe Origin Source’s full suppression.

Was the Galaxy Ultimate Being a fool?

Clearly not.

Then it could only be the second possibility.

“Galaxy Ultimate Being!”

The Twelve-Layer alien beings exchanged glances, their minds trembling in unison.

…

“The migration can proceed.”

Beneath the starry skies, Lin Yuan gazed at the countless human civilization citizens being sent over from all directions, his thoughts stirring.

The human race’s migration unfolded at remarkable speed, cutting time short by skipping the emotional farewells between citizens.

“Divine Skills… World!”

Lin Yuan looked down, his thoughts shifting slightly, and immediately a boundless force surged to cover an area spanning twenty million light-years.

Every human civilization citizen within this sphere was engulfed and enveloped in an instant.

“Withdraw!”

Lin Yuan’s expression remained calm; in the blink of an eye, everything within twenty million light-years vanished and was transferred into Lin Yuan’s internal universe.

At this moment.

Countless human civilization citizens noticed the change in environment, as an invisible form of suppression emerged.

Even though Lin Yuan had performed numerous calibrations to stabilize the internal universe’s space and time, it still bore noticeable distinctions from the Cosmic Starry Skies of the Main Universe.

Slightly stronger evolution practitioners who paid careful attention would detect the anomalies.

However, the impact was minimal. Stable spacetime barely affected ordinary citizens—it mainly restricted high-level evolutionists, preventing them from casually executing spatial transpositions or tearing through the void.

Even Twelve-Layer Ultimate Beings faced pervasive suppression within Lin Yuan’s internal universe, making it impossible to escape.

The “Infinite Void” aimed to cultivate an internal universe modeled after the Chaos Void as its ultimate form; theoretically, when perfected, such an internal universe could evolve into a colossal entity comparable to the Chaos Void.

Thus, the spacetime stability was self-evident, even at just the First Layer. If advanced to the Second or Third Layer, Chaos Venerables entrapped within would find themselves shackled, unable to struggle free.

“The Galaxy Ultimate Being’s methods are terrifying.”

Not far away, nine Ultimate Beings of human civilization watched, utterly astonished.

Within an instant, Lin Yuan had relocated all human civilization citizens spanning twenty million light-years?
